summary: Retained candidate 642e52a8e98ede176a3c4942bd18f926b40b3434's valid DeepSeek V3.2 extraction and corrected its remaining source-level counterexample by extracting NPU MHA/MLA/DSA dispatch into a lazy hardware mixin. This is not a claim of complete architecture or model-runtime qualification.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before structural reproduction at exact candidate commit: the hardware_backend package and NPU mixin were absent.
22 tests and 8 subtests covering retained V3.2 policy plus MHA/MLA/DSA NPU prepare/core routing and DSA previous-top-k argument forwarding.
Applicable formatting, lint, syntax, security, and CI registration checks.
On AMD Instinct MI350X, empty DSA top-k output matched an independent torch.empty reference for CUDA/ROCm device, int32 dtype, and (0, 2048) shape.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-01d336ff3a3a/evidence/gpu-device-after.log; AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. This validates allocation placement only, not Indexer numerics or model semantics.

remaining_limitations: No NPU execution; NPU dispatch is verified with mocks only.
No DeepSeek V3.2 checkpoint or weights; Indexer/IndexerKPool execution, checkpoint compatibility, logits, and semantic accuracy remain unverified.
No multi-GPU or pipeline-parallel stage-boundary execution.
NVIDIA, CPU-only, MUSA, and other architecture-specific runtime paths were not executed.
Dedicated AMD and CPU wrapper mixins were not added without a demonstrated defect; existing separate ROCm and CPU attention-forward mixins were preserved.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
